tickets.title: The render acknowledgement answers at durable admission (**amendment 5, 2026-10-19**)

authority.requirement: see amendment 5 section 2, ticket P56 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A storefront's acknowledgement of a rendered decision answers within the SDK's deadline on both hosts, so engagement, viewable and dwell are no longer lost after a cut, while the admission stays durable and the effects follow in order.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, an acknowledgement of a rendered-v1 decision answers 200 with render status durable and source pending once both source admissions are committed, while the queue send is held unresolved; after release and drain a same-id re-send answers source recovered, one ledger row exists and the exposure is counted once.
criteria.proof: The P56 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P56.AA1 in src/units/P56 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Under the parity harness with one tenth of the SDK's named deadline added to every remote binding call, the acknowledgement answers in under that deadline on both hosts (RED today: at least 28 serial calls).
criteria.proof: The P56 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P56.AA2 in src/units/P56 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A content_click sent immediately after a pending acknowledgement is attributed to that decision on both hosts (the ring append ran first in the serializer).
criteria.proof: The P56 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P56.AA3 in src/units/P56 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: the durable admission transaction, its logical keys and first-admission deadline, W06's recovery id and payload digests, the idempotent replay, the redemption checks and an admission failure failing the acknowledgement behave byte for byte as today; every unit that read source recovered on a first acknowledgement is updated in R10 form naming amendment 5.
criteria.proof: The P56 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P56.AA4 in src/units/P56 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.

existingEvidence.description: Path, local reproduction (135 ms, 30/28 serial remote calls), the hosted 5.1–6.0 s on the stamps (R-P96), the conflict 500 reproduced 13/13.

remainingWork: Mechanism: runOwnerRecovery opt-in that returns the receipt after savePayload and armRecovery and hands resumeOwnerRecovery to a post-answer continuation that re-enters through the owner's serializer and waitUntil, never through retainOwnerWork; carried through admitOwnedRecovery and ShopperReflex.admitRecovery; opted in by recoverDecisions from redeemRenderOffer and by captureBehavior on the same request.
SDK: the 5 s literal exported as a named constant for the budget test (the behaviour change of the SDK is P60).
R10 updates of every expectation that read recovered on a first acknowledgement, named by the specifier.

tickets.title: A same-id acknowledgement re-send is idempotent; a conflicting one answers a typed 409, never an untyped 500 (**amendment 5, 2026-10-19**)

authority.requirement: see amendment 5 section 2, ticket P57 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A retried acknowledgement never fails the storefront with a 500: the same render gets its original receipt, a genuinely different event on an acknowledged decision is told so with a 409.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a first delivery whose client timestamp is 3 s ahead of the engine followed by a same-id, same-pageInstance re-send answers 200 twice with identical receipts and one ledger row and one behaviour record (RED today: the second answers 500 Recovery logical conflict).
criteria.proof: The P57 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P57.RC1 in src/units/P57 and they pass.

criteria.observable: A different eventId on an already-acknowledged decision answers a typed 409 whose body names the conflict, on both hosts, and no second ledger row is written.
criteria.proof: The P57 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P57.RC2 in src/units/P57 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: W23's first-delivery clamp (realtime.ts:166-184), sourceOf and the payload digest unchanged; the in-flight same-id duplicate still answers 200 recovered; the owner's drain never answers an untyped 500 after the route answered.
criteria.proof: The P57 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P57.RC3 in src/units/P57 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.

existingEvidence.description: Path, local reproduction (135 ms, 30/28 serial remote calls), the hosted 5.1–6.0 s on the stamps (R-P96), the conflict 500 reproduced 13/13.

remainingWork: Before realtime.ts's render time is fixed, read this decision's stored admission through an owner-held helper in recovery.ts (same id and payloadOf); reuse its rendered.at when eventId and pageInstance match and pass the same time to captureBehavior; otherwise throw a typed conflict mapped to 409 in ShopperReflex and the owner app's onError.

decisions.authorityRef: R-P99 (_evidence/parity-step3/AMENDMENTS.md, 2026-10-19) under the owner's standing rule R-P78
decisions.effect: Same eventId and pageInstance on the same decision is the same render: idempotent 200 with the original receipt; a different eventId is a conflict: typed 409.

authority.locator: P59 · section 2 of amendment 5; ANALYSIS.md out-of-scope note 1
authority.requirement: see amendment 5 section 2, ticket P59 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A content_click answers within the SDK's deadline on both hosts; its attribution and ledger rows are unchanged.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a content_click after an acknowledged decision answers 200 while the queue send is held unresolved; after release and drain the outcome row and its attribution exist once.
criteria.proof: The P59 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P59.CO1 in src/units/P59 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Under the parity harness with one tenth of the SDK's named deadline per remote call, content_click answers in under that deadline on both hosts.
criteria.proof: The P59 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P59.CO2 in src/units/P59 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: attribution to the decision, the reward row and P56/P58 units unchanged.
criteria.proof: The P59 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P59.CO3 in src/units/P59 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

tickets.title: The SDK's deadline is one named constant, a cut acknowledgement is retried once with the same event id, and a recovered retry keeps the placement's engagement (**amendment 5, 2026-10-19**)

authority.locator: P60 · section 2 of amendment 5; ANALYSIS.md §4 'SDK half'
authority.requirement: see amendment 5 section 2, ticket P60 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A slow acknowledgement no longer silently drops a placement's engagement, viewable and dwell; the SDK's deadline is one named value.

criteria.observable: The 5 s literal is one exported constant used by session mint, snapshot, acknowledgement and the fourth call that shares it (core.ts:792, :805, :973, :1014); no other 5000 literal remains on those paths.
criteria.proof: The P60 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P60.SD1 in src/units/P60 and they pass.

criteria.observable: After a cut acknowledgement the SDK re-sends the same envelope (same eventId) once; a retry answered recovered or pending leaves engagement, viewable and dwell armed for that placement (RED today: listen.ts:497-502 suppresses them).
criteria.proof: The P60 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P60.SD2 in src/units/P60 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: one envelope per placement; the bundles within their byte budgets; build-sdk.mjs --check an exact match; the SDK typecheck green.
criteria.proof: The P60 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P60.SD3 in src/units/P60 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.
criteria.proof: The LIVE1 walkthrough record.

existingEvidence.description: Path, local reproduction (135 ms, 30/28 serial remote calls), the hosted 5.1–6.0 s on the stamps (R-P96), the conflict 500 reproduced 13/13.

remainingWork: Name the constant; retry once after a cut with the same envelope; keep the placement's listeners armed when the retry is answered.
